description: LLM Analytics — UI Bridge Cost Attribution extensions. Adds Cost by Target App chart, Cost per Interaction chart, Page Complexity table, and Model x Action Success Matrix to the existing LLM Observability Dashboard. These components surface which apps and pages cost most to automate, and which model/action combinations are most effective. Data flows from phase_token_usage.target_app (set via get_active_sdk_app_name() during agentic phase execution) and joins with ui_bridge_events for per-interaction cost analysis.

groups.description: Four new components are conditionally rendered in the LLM Observability Dashboard when target_app data exists in phase_token_usage: CostByTargetAppChart (horizontal bar), CostPerInteractionChart (vertical bar), PageComplexityTable (ranked table), and ModelActionMatrix (heatmap). All components are lazy-loaded.
groups.name: UI Bridge Cost Components Presence

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Cost Attribution Data Display

target.label: Required element for Cost Attribution Data Display

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Cost Attribution Data Display

target.label: Required element for Cost Attribution Data Display

groups.description: CostByTargetAppChart shows a horizontal bar chart sorted by cost descending. Custom tooltip shows app name, cost ($X.XX), calls, input/output tokens, and avg duration. Uses hsl(var(--chart-3)) fill. CostPerInteractionChart shows vertical bars with first 20 task runs, x-axis shows truncated run IDs, y-axis shows cost ($X.XX). PageComplexityTable has 4 columns: Page URL (monospace truncated), Calls, Total Cost, Avg/Call (bold). Sorted by avg cost descending. Sticky header with max-h-64 scroll.
groups.name: Cost Attribution Data Display

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Model-Action Matrix Color Semantics
assertions.precondition: phase_token_usage and ui_bridge_events have data for the same task_run_ids

target.label: Required element for Model-Action Matrix Color Semantics

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Model-Action Matrix Color Semantics
assertions.precondition: phase_token_usage and ui_bridge_events have data for the same task_run_ids

target.label: Required element for Model-Action Matrix Color Semantics

groups.description: The heatmap matrix uses color coding to communicate model/action effectiveness: green (>= 95% success), yellow (>= 80%), orange (>= 50%), red (< 50%). Each cell shows success rate (bold %) and attempt count (muted Nx). Empty cells show '-'. Rows are model names (font-mono), columns are action types (font-mono). Only cells with >= 3 attempts are shown to ensure statistical significance.
groups.name: Model-Action Matrix Color Semantics

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Empty and Loading States
assertions.precondition: No phase_token_usage rows have target_app set

target.label: Required element for Empty and Loading States

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Empty and Loading States
assertions.precondition: No phase_token_usage rows have target_app set

target.label: Required element for Empty and Loading States

groups.description: Each component handles empty and loading states independently. CostByTargetAppChart: 'No UI Bridge cost data available' (only shown when target_app data exists, otherwise hidden entirely). CostPerInteractionChart: 'No interaction cost data'. PageComplexityTable: 'No page cost data'. ModelActionMatrix: 'No model-action data'. All show 'Loading...' during fetch.
groups.name: Empty and Loading States

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Time Range Interaction

target.label: Required element for Time Range Interaction

groups.description: The LLM dashboard's existing time range selector (1d/7d/30d/all) controls the days parameter for all cost attribution queries. CostByTargetAppChart fetches from /analytics/token-usage/by-target-app?days=N. CostPerInteractionChart fetches from /analytics/token-usage/cost-per-interaction?days=N. Changing the time range should update all four new charts.
groups.name: Time Range Interaction

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Cost Attribution Pipeline Behavior
assertions.precondition: At least one workflow was run against an SDK-connected app during its agentic phase

target.label: Required element for Cost Attribution Pipeline Behavior

groups.description: Cost attribution data flows from the agentic phase executor. When a workflow step involves UI Bridge actions, get_active_sdk_app_name() extracts the connected app name via try_lock on the SDK connection manager, and record_phase_token_usage_with_target() writes it to phase_token_usage.target_app. This means cost attribution only appears for workflows that interact with SDK-connected apps during their agentic phase.
groups.name: Cost Attribution Pipeline Behavior
